fusions.name: Bait and Clatter
fusions.desc: Clangs your plates together, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles. Each has a 40% chance to be left [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dirty Finish
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to a blow that deals 20 damage.

fusions.name: Sleight of Steel
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Barely Counted
fusions.desc: Once every 240 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
